ablations.removed: validated numeric priors and routing hints

ablations.replacement: global scrambled Sobol with equal candidate budget

claim_boundaries: No optimizer-superiority claim is made before all paired primary cells finish.
Official AutoTuner is compared on the common domain; the full-domain portfolio is compared only with full-domain random and Sobol controls.
A successful run proves execution only; optimization requires repeated common-evaluator statistics.
The six primary blocks provide moderate power for large effects, not universal EDA generalization.

endpoint_definitions.empirical_attainment: at each frozen checkpoint, fraction of design-PDK by optimizer-seed cells that reached first_baseline_improvement, with Wilson 95% interval; nonattainment remains right-censored at budget
endpoint_definitions.first_baseline_improvement: first logical round whose repeated finish evaluation is hard-constraint eligible and whose observed balanced relative utility is strictly greater than zero; positive hypervolume alone is not improvement

execution.completion_gate: controller/protocol failure invalidates the cell; only a complete fixed logical budget may enter aggregation
execution.external_artifact_namespace: Official AutoTuner experiment names include study mode, protocol digest, design-PDK, optimizer seed, OR_SEED and logical budget; interrupted cells resume only that immutable Ray experiment and append controller attempts
execution.final_replay: all reported incumbents/Pareto points are replayed at finish with the same three paired OR_SEED values
execution.source_freeze: campaign-wide digest over runner plus all local Python evaluator, contract, execution and scheduler sources

freeze_policy: append-only; any change creates a new study_id and digest

hard_constraints.rule: NaN, missing final metrics, timeout and tool failure are infeasible

metric_contract.asap7_rule: public period/slack values are ns; official SDC ps literals remain byte-identical
metric_contract.runtime_evidence_policy: every formal finish evaluation records finite positive wall time; native Runtime uses summed stage duration, upstream AutoTuner uses Ray time_total_s, and paired replay uses controller monotonic time
metric_contract.time_unit_rule: read run__flow__platform__time_units from ORFS JSON and reject missing, conflicting, or unsupported unit evidence

optimization_policy.acquisition: constrained qLogNEHVI over a deduplicated mixed candidate pool
optimization_policy.external_baseline_warm_start: Official AutoTuner receives the same frozen baseline as one explicit points_to_evaluate observation; the upstream controller runs budget+1 samples, while the baseline is labeled uncharged and only the remaining budget candidates enter optimizer endpoints
optimization_policy.feasibility_model: configuration-caused ORFS quick/full failures and final hard-constraint violations; infrastructure failures are retained but excluded from GP fitting
optimization_policy.initialization: before surrogate fitting, expand from a hard-constraint-feasible observed anchor with one-factor-at-a-time scrambled Sobol points; defer high-order combinations, retain every failure in budget, and fall back to global Sobol when no feasible anchor exists
optimization_policy.objective_noise: replica-derived mean variance with a positive floor
optimization_policy.stall_route: after initialization, three non-improving full configurations switch the portfolio route without ending the fixed budget
optimization_policy.surrogate: independent ARD Matern-5/2 SingleTaskGP per objective

primary_endpoints: observed feasible hypervolume at every budget checkpoint
anytime feasible-hypervolume area under the evaluation curve
evaluations to first feasible baseline-improving point

reproducibility.python_environment_policy: campaign and every cell bind a canonical fingerprint of the actual controller Python plus numpy, scipy, torch, gpytorch, botorch, optuna, ray and hyperopt versions; Official cells additionally fingerprint the external AutoTuner virtual environment

search_domains.clock_sdc_policy: frozen per design-PDK block and excluded from every search arm
search_domains.common: intersection of controlled-liveness calibration and pinned official AutoTuner variables.yaml tunable=1
search_domains.external_optimizer_design_adapter: content-addressed execution namespace copies the exact reference RTL, include files, SDC, HDL frontend, design options and baseline flow parameters; reports retain the logical design and source fingerprint
search_domains.fixed_nonsearch_policy: server baseline values; never omitted or optimizer-selected

secondary_endpoints: area, WNS, TNS, power, DRC, wall time and failure rate
median, IQR, paired bootstrap 95% CI and empirical attainment

statistics.aggregation_rule: never pool EDA replicas or optimizer seeds as independent primary samples; report all 18 seed cells descriptively, aggregate their three seeds within each design-PDK block for inference
statistics.familywise_control: Holm correction over preregistered primary arm contrasts
statistics.primary_test: paired sign-flip permutation across six design-PDK blocks on the preregistered median-over-seeds anytime-HV AUC difference
statistics.reporting_rule: report every seed, failure, exclusion, timeout and checkpoint
statistics.unit: design-PDK block after median aggregation across optimizer seeds

stopping.algorithmic: fixed maximum budget; checkpoints do not stop a losing arm
stopping.engineering: only explicit timeout, disk guard, cancellation or toolchain invalidation
stopping.stall_routing: three non-improving full configurations change optimizer route, not study budget

title: Calibrated multi-objective design-space exploration in OpenROAD
